description: Writes and reviews phased, executable, verifiable, reviewable, rollback-aware software engineering plans with plan-to-code completeness evidence for implementation, refactor, migration, rollout, bug-fix, performance, security, and DevOps work.

changes: Add plan-to-code implementation completeness evidence to Standard and Full plan contracts.
Define landed, partial, stub-only, mock-only, planned, and deferred implementation statuses.
Require production code path, integration entry, test evidence, runtime/log evidence, and mock/stub exposure in code-bearing plans.
Update sanity checks and exemplar coverage for implementation completeness.
